title: The Mural Built by a Neighborhood
short_teaser: Community murals combine many voices, sketches, stories, and hands into one shared image.
story: Community murals combine many voices, sketches, stories, and hands into one shared image. Co-creation can turn a surface into a record of belonging. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Co-creation can turn a surface into a record of belonging. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning.
